currentStateEvidence.baseline: HEAD 910e624; test-browse-unit hung in CI run 35440413429 (Repository gates), while test-enforcement/orchestrate/contracts passed. daemon.test.mjs:142 asserted daemon exit code -1 (waitExit timeout).
observations: waitExit(child, ms) resolves -1 on timeout and never kills the child (csm-browse/tests/unit/daemon.test.mjs:32-40).
The readiness poll (daemon.ready) asserts on timeout but leaks the spawned daemon.
The daemon's cleanup has a 3s force-exit backstop after CDP close (session-daemon.mjs:334-340).

design.approach: Diagnose (T001), fix daemon determinism (T002) and harness leak-proofing (T003) in parallel, then prove determinism under repetition/load (T004).
design.authority: Unchanged; csm-browse is not a coordination entry.

discoveredRequirements.requirement: The harness must kill+reap on any timeout; the daemon must exit bounded on disconnect; the protocol must not change.

constraints: Non-disruptive: no change to the daemon's CDP/HTTP/pid/ready-marker contract or the session protocol other agents use.
Build in an isolated worktree (csm-browse is live-used in the shared skills dir).
The fix must make the test deterministic (no hangs, no leaked child/server handles).
